study_name: F5-C每日生产总球收缩前瞻政策对照
frozen_algorithm_ancestor: F5-B total_shrink_v1; daily baseline and actual observed-result selector form a new prospective implementation version

candidate.baseline: the exact same daily production 180-day forecast, no second fitting, no weekly-research substitution

mean.eligible_set: exact parent production fitter eligible training rows; ordered training digest must match

candidate.alpha_zero: reuse saved production probabilities exactly; reconstructed matrix only from original rates and original function
candidate.operational_fallback: if same-cutoff mean/grid/selection unavailable, predeclare alpha=0 and persist the production forecast as candidate before kickoff with typed reason; never after-result impute
candidate.UNL_MLS_v2: separate exploratory protocols; never replace this main candidate after results

selector.loss: exact untruncated total Poisson negative log probability
selector.weighting: one equal weight per unique competition+match_id
selector.forecast_requirement: new F5 grid durably captured before kickoff; no reconstructed historical forecasts or old F4 records without genuine F5 grid receipts
selector.latest_result_version: only result versions with their own observed_and_saved_at <= current input_cutoff; retain raw hash and identity
selector.previous_origin: pool forecast origin strictly earlier than current origin
selector.deduplication: first baseline-valid F5 opportunity per competition+match_id in selector-support cohort; all grid scores use that same source
selector.cold_start: alpha=0 is a policy forecast; retain in main results and report pool size, excluded reasons and fallback
selector.same_origin: freeze one choice for all current league matches; never revise halfway through a batch
selector.support_population: pilot and confirmation grids may support selection only when truly mature; pilot never joins confirmation denominator

stages.pilot: this first implementation and real-cloud acceptance are engineering only; no confirmation activation this turn
engineering_gate: same daily parent input/model/eligible-training mean binding
capacity-budget check and final cloud state commit receipt
complete request, fallback and late-save logs
stages.activation_requirement: separate immutable activation record after pilot acceptance; bind finalized source/module/protocol hashes and a future exact start_at. No automatic activation from preparation or a successful pilot.
stages.start_requirement: activation durable timestamp precedes exact start_at and first confirmation input_cutoff; begin from the first later lawful opportunity, never reclassify pilot receipts
stages.official_check: Exactly once: close at the first outcome-blind scheduled daily checkpoint where both enrolled unique baseline opportunities >=10000 and elapsed calendar time >=365 days, or at 548 days from actual activated start, whichever earlier. Continue the complete intake stream until closure; count is a minimum target, not a 10000 hard cap. Never use scored-pair count or observed effect to choose enrollment or closure.
stages.grace_rule: after the outcome-blind cohort closure, allow 14 days for already-enrolled results and revisions; no new enrollment, parameter changes, or second success check
stages.partial_block: keep and report partial final block; do not count it toward minimum full-block support
stages.sample_planning: historical paired SD=0.167573; true delta -0.01 vs zero, one-sided alpha .025, 80% normal planning requires ~2205 IID or ~8817 at design effect 4. 9000 is planning, not power assurance.
stages.insufficient_action: After one fixed14-day result grace, fewer than9000 validated unique FT pairs, fewer than365days, fewer than13 full nonempty28day blocks, failed coverage or dependence support means inconclusive. Do not top up on observed scoring completeness, restart clock, retroactively recruit pilot or extend on favorable results.
stages.impossible_old_combination_corrected: 40 disjoint 28-day blocks require >=1120 days; they cannot fit a 548-day maximum. Moving overlapping windows must not be counted as independent blocks.
stages.planning_slack: 10000 lawful enrollments allows a prespecified planning margin of 10% for predeclared voids or unavailable results relative to 9000 valid pairs. This is a feasibility assumption, not an allowed 10% silent capture failure or a power guarantee.
stages.cohort_at_count_time_closure: Keep every lawful opportunity through the predeclared daily closure checkpoint; disclose overshoot. If 10000 arrives before day365, continue the complete intake stream to day365. If day365 arrives first, continue until count reaches10000 or day548. At day548 close even if sample short.

cohort.full_scope: all daily next-7-day requests in these 18 competitions after activated start; register requests before filtering
cohort.primary_unit: competition+match_id, not saved version or arm
cohort.primary_forecast: first request with an eligible durably pre-kickoff production baseline in confirmation; candidate success is not used to choose the request
cohort.candidate_failure: first selected baseline-valid request fixes the candidate opportunity; no substitution by a later successful version
cohort.later_versions: retain as updates with parent identity, outside main sample count
cohort.late_commit: local fsync before kickoff but durable cloud state commit completion at/after kickoff is a late-cloud-persistence record; not authenticated confirmation
cohort.reschedule: preserve old identity and append revision; only forecasts actually calculated and durably completed before real kickoff can qualify; no retrospective identity repair
cohort.regulation_time: 90 minutes plus injury time; excludes extra time and penalties; ambiguity stays unknown
cohort.voids: Cancelled/abandoned without a certified regulation result are predeclared voids, separately counted; they need not make the entire study inconclusive if >=9000 valid pairs and remaining gates pass. No zero score.
cohort.unresolved: At final close all unresolved-result opportunities remain in the enrolled denominator and unscored. Predeclared unresolved-result limit is1% of enrolled baseline opportunities. Even within this limit, primary effect claim applies only to the verified-regulation-result population; no unsupported all-opportunity effectiveness claim.
cohort.coverage_success: Every validated-FT baseline-eligible opportunity in the main inferential population must have a genuine before-kickoff selected candidate or genuine alpha0 policy fallback and valid remote receipt. Any missing candidate on a verifiedFT blocks main success; report the scored-pair subset descriptively. Voids are separate operational outcomes.
cohort.estimand: Equal-match total log-loss difference for enrolled baseline opportunities with independently verified regulation FT and genuine complete captured pair. Outcome-incomplete opportunities and voids are separately enumerated; operational quality is measured on the full enrolled opportunity stream.

required: outcome/void/capture/late/missing counts and rates by league, lead time, selected-alpha/cold-start, calendar block
baseline distribution and forecast covariates for scored versus absent-result opportunities
the complete main paired estimate plus prespecified finite adverse-missing scenarios: mean absent-result deltas +0.1,+0.25,+0.5; never actual imputed primary outcomes
missing_sensitivity.limit: total Poisson log loss is unbounded, so finite adverse scenarios are sensitivity analyses only; they cannot prove the missing all-opportunity effect is nonnegative/negative. If missingness mechanism, source continuity or dependence support is doubtful, retain shadow and report inconclusive.

score.primary: equal-match mean of candidate total_log_loss minus baseline total_log_loss
score.over2_5: Brier from original normalized matrix, same as F5-B; retain original tail mass
score.one_x_two: -log(max(1e-15,p_actual)) from saved normalized matrix; retain floor counts and mathematical zero diagnostics
score.joint_score_ll: analytic independent-Poisson joint score; paired difference equals total_LL delta under fixed home/away ratio, not independent evidence
score.accuracy: argmax 1X2 accuracy, descriptive and separate from probability quality
score.fixed_grid_results: exploratory, all reported; cannot replace past_selected main candidate
score.calibration: event scores use every opportunity; realized 0-goal or 8+-goal subsets only diagnostic decomposition
score.ROI_EV: not evaluated here; requires independent lawful decision, quote and execution evidence

dependence.unit: one shared UTC calendar for all competitions; paired ratio of sums
dependence.primary_interval: shared nonoverlapping 28-day calendar block bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 20261008, two-sided percentile 95%
dependence.sensitivity_interval: shared 56-day contiguous moving-block bootstrap over daily vectors, 2000 replicates, same seed; moving windows are not extra independent blocks
dependence.conservative_upper: max(primary 97.5% upper, 56-day sensitivity 97.5% upper), for every main/guardrail metric
dependence.empty_days: retain zero sums/counts; never omit calendar gaps before resampling
dependence.resample_sharing: same sampled global blocks for all metrics and all leagues, preserving within-block cross-league dependence
dependence.scope_limit: 13 blocks remain few; recurring teams, season changes and cross-block dependence are not proven eliminated. Unstable or longer-range dependence means inconclusive, not promotion.
dependence.equal_league_weight: separate predeclared sensitivity estimand, never replaces equal-match primary

success_requires_all: engineering, prespecified conditional verified-FT cohort, candidate-capture coverage, <=1% unresolved-result rate and dependence-support gates passed
>=9000 unique validated FT pairs and >=365 days and >=13 nonempty full nonoverlapping 28-day blocks
primary point delta <= -0.01 and conservative upper < 0
over2.5 Brier point delta <= 0 and conservative upper <= 0
1X2 Log loss point delta <= +0.005 and conservative upper <= +0.005
equal-league primary mean delta <= 0, with all 18 league strata completely disclosed

no unresolved hash/identity/time invalidity in the main verifiedFT population; all excluded, void, capture failure and absent-result opportunities disclosed; missing sensitivity and source-continuity review passed
final_decision.allowed_claim: Probability quality improved in the prospectively captured verified-regulation-result opportunity population under the frozen daily policy; observed mean meets worthwhile0.01 target. At least0.01 confirmed improvement requires upper<=-0.01. Full opportunity operation and missingness are separately disclosed; no proof of effect on unresolved opportunities or profit.
final_decision.per_league: aggregate success does not authorize blanket replacement of all 18 leagues; per-league effects require separate sufficient evidence
final_decision.promotion: no automatic production or betting promotion; final independent review and concrete deployment decision are separate
final_decision.failure: retain candidate shadow-only and seal results; no retuning this run
final_decision.inconclusive: production unchanged; no outcome-based extension or selective promotion

monitoring.allowed: validity, full requests, parent hashes, result errors, capacity, authentication, elapsed time and sample counts
monitoring.selector_access: the frozen adaptive selector uses its prescribed mature scores, but interim aggregate effects cannot trigger adoption, retuning, early success or selective suspension
monitoring.hard_stop: hash/time/identity corruption stops affected candidate capture with an explicit failure; production continues
monitoring.ordinary_failure: before-kickoff alpha0 fallback if possible; otherwise retain failure, never zero score
monitoring.algorithm_bug_change: seal attempt and start a new version for changed predictions, selection, cohort or scores; only proof-preserving reader fixes may retain existing artifacts after exact outcome-invariance review

pre_activation_corrections.status: prepared draft amended before activation; no production or live confirmation protocol changed
pre_activation_corrections.reason: A stop triggered by 9000 scored pairs can extend enrollment based on outcome availability and completeness. Use 9000 lawful enrolled independent baseline opportunities, including candidate failures and missing results. Missing valid pairs remain insufficient after the fixed grace period.
pre_activation_corrections.previous_wording: 9000 valid unique scored pairs or 548 days, whichever first
pre_activation_corrections.current_wording: 9000 lawful unique enrolled baseline opportunities or 548 days, whichever first
pre_activation_corrections.no_automatic_ITT_imputation: A prospective pre-kickoff baseline fallback is valid if saved under policy; retrospective failure-to-zero ITT is not introduced. Any alternative missing/fallback design must be set before activation.

pre_activation_corrections.status: v2 preparation only; v1 original retained, no live protocol changed
pre_activation_corrections.reason: Separate prespecified enrollment planning margin from valid-pair support; require both calendar support and count before closure, with a548day hard end. Explicit voids do not each force failure; missing FT stays unknown, limited inference, independent sensitivity and operational denominator.
pre_activation_corrections.no_relaxation: grid, means, selector180day/40/48h, main worthwhile0.01, Brier/1X2 guardrails, >=9000 FT pairs, >=365days,13 full blocks and dependence limitations remain.

activation_rules.requirement: new immutable durable activation record bound to finalized preparation/source hashes and future exact start. Prepared JSON/freeze/readiness receipt is not activation. Pilot records cannot be reclassified.
activation_rules.current: total_shrink_shadow remains pilot with confirmation_eligible=false; current real scored/mature pair and sustainable whole-horizon capacity are not established, so activation is blocked.
